data.description: [RECOVERY] Report's numbers WRONG: full-file scan finds 263 trajectories using 'git checkout --' vs 62 using 'git reset --hard' (not 322 vs 5). The '5x' likely counted only full-40-char-SHA resets — an apples-to-oranges comparison. Directional claim survives: surgical revert outnumbers repo-wide reset ~4.2:1. Exemplar args byte-verified via leaf scan. Caveat: 'overwhelmingly targets files the agent itself just edited' has counterexamples (e.g. 'git checkout -- .' tree-wide reverts observed). Grade cut MEDIUM->LOW: descriptive stat of normal git usage, no misbehavior.
